frames.odom: fixed right-handed, metres, z up; zero aligned to a MEASURED initial support plane, never inferred from base-origin z
frames.lidar_xyz: current yaw-only navigation frame; foot/support-relative height, already deskewed upstream
frames.lidar_sensor_xyz: raw sensor xyz with matching lidar_sensor_valid and scan-time T_odom_lidar [4,4]
frames.T_odom_depth_optical: column-vector optical right/down/forward to fixed odom, matching depth exposure
frames.support_odom_z: measured/estimated current support origin in the declared odom; simulation uses ideal sensor pose

full_metric_depth: depth_m float[H,W] in metres, never raw uint16 or DA2 relative depth
hardware_sensor_protocol: r5_mid360_d435i_downward_rgb_calibrated_v2; primary rgb is the same downward D435i image, resized for S1; no additional forward RGB input
timestamp_contract: full acquisition-time SE(3), including roll/pitch, before ground segmentation; moving real scans require upstream per-return deskew and synchronization
simulation_limits: coverage sampling is NOT Livox non-repetitive scan timing
mount transforms are simulation fixtures, not measured hardware calibration
missing support is unknown; a censored frontier may request SAFE_STOP without being claimed as a measured negative drop
ground material head is simulation-domain only
mode_control: mode argument: vanilla_s1 / s1_astar_v4 / s1_guided_flow_2d / s1_guided_flow_25d_full; default stays s1_astar_v4

outputs.diagnostic.mode: NORMAL_TROT / STAIR_CLIMB / IMPASSABLE_HIGH / SAFE_STOP / YIELD_WAIT; terminal stop additionally reported
